sentences.text: Imtechella halotolerans is a Gram-negative bacterium used as one of two species in a spike-in control developed for quantifying absolute microbial abundance.
In that study, a spike-in of 100,000 cells each of Imtechella halotolerans and Allobacillus halotolerans was used to quantify microbiota abundance in 100 mg of pig jejunal mucosa.
A preprint describes spiking more than a thousand human faecal microbiome samples with these two strains, which it states are not otherwise present in human faecal samples.

references.title: Quantification of the absolute abundance of the jejunal mucosa-associated microbiota of pigs using spike-in control
